title: Standby LP → Fire Princess planning and fail-closed atomic persistence gate

scenarios: Dancing Fairy (1000 LP) + Fire Princess (500 damage): M444/M452 planners compute the exact team-0 result while preserving the physical owner seat, but M454 storage rejects the state as invalid-tag-session-state because these cards are not yet admitted; session revision, LP and ledgers remain unchanged.
Darklord Marie (200 LP) + Fire Princess (500 damage): activation-time UID snapshot and team-1 routing are correct; storage fails closed for the same admission gate, without partial writes.
A certified-only TagDuel state accepts a generic M452 LP plan; M454 commits both LP totals and both ledgers atomically, duplicate retry is idempotent, and a stale session revision is rejected.

admissionGate.observed: The current M454 base card certification registry does not include the Standby/Fire Princess candidate IDs; assertTagDuel rejects these states before storage mutation.
admissionGate.nextRequirement: Complete card admission/certification through the normal behavioral gate before allowing these source cards into a persisted TagDuel session.
